howToReach.text: The nearest Airport to Sattal is Pantnagar Airport situated 61kms from Sattal. (Pick can be arranged)
The nearest railhead to Sattal is Kathgodam situated 33kms from Sattal. (Pick up can be arranged)
Sattal is well connected by motorable roads connecting major cities and towns of Uttarakhand state. it takes only 6 hours to reach Sattal
